blocks.content: This chapter covers UT-specific development projects and the local rollout of pan-India flagship schemes — both frequently tested in current-affairs-linked questions for this UT.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Detailing of UT-specific recent flagship initiatives in Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.
Implementation and alignment of Pan-India flagship schemes within the DNH&DD local context.
Strategic focus on industrial growth and investment promotion in the region.

blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: Several of these projects (Aviary at Jampore, NAMO Medical Institute, Zanda Chowk School, Ghoghla PMAY flats/STP) were all inaugurated or visited during the President's and Vice-President's back-to-back official tours of the UT in September-November 2024 — a useful cluster of current-affairs facts to remember together.
Pan-India Flagship Schemes in DNH&DD Context

items: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) — both rural and urban components have been rolled out, with visible urban housing delivery in Diu (Ghoghla flats) as a showcase example.
Swachh Bharat Mission — sanitation infrastructure (including the Diu Sewage Treatment Plant) has been developed under this umbrella alongside broader cleanliness drives across all three districts.
Ayushman Bharat and the National Health Mission have been extended to the UT, complemented locally by the new NAMO Medical Education and Research Institute's hospital facilities.

Blue Flag beach certification (an international eco-label administered under a Denmark-based foundation, adopted by India's Ministry of Environment) has been secured for Ghoghla Beach, Diu — one of a select group of Indian beaches to hold this certification.

The UT Administration's Industries Department continues to promote Dadra & Nagar Haveli's industrial estates (Silvassa, Masat, Khadoli, Piparia) through single-window clearance systems and investment incentives aimed at small and medium enterprises.

Skill-development and vocational training initiatives target the UT's substantial migrant industrial workforce and its tribal youth population, aiming to improve local employability in the manufacturing sector.
